summary: v2.5.6 Feature Testing Complete - All features verified working. Movies/TV Shows/Anime pages have dual Library/Discover views. Gadgets Catalogue shows 45 gadgets across 16 categories. Downloads engine status working.

movies_page.details: Movies page loads with My Library and Discover tabs. Library view shows 3 local libraries (Movies, Test Movies, Test Scan Tmp). Discover view shows TMDB movies with genre filters.

tv_shows_page.details: TV Shows page loads with My Library and Discover tabs. Library view shows empty state with 'Add Your First Library' option. Discover view shows popular TV shows with genre filters.

anime_page.details: Anime page loads with anime-specific pink/purple styling. Library view shows empty state. Discover view shows Japanese animation with ANIME badges, genre filters (All Anime, Animation, Action & Adventure, etc).

downloads_page.details: Downloads page loads showing 'Built-in Engine Running' status with green indicator. Built-in/qBittorrent toggle working. DHT nodes, download/upload speed displayed. Add Magnet button available.

gadgets_catalogue.details: Plugin Marketplace page (/plugins) shows Gadgets Catalogue tab with 16 categories and 45 gadgets. Categories include Metadata Providers (6), Subtitle Services (4), Notification Services (5), Visual Themes (4), etc. Search functionality working - found 'Herald Discord Notifier' when searching 'discord'.

backend_api_gadgets_catalogue.details: /api/gadgets/catalogue returns 45 items and 16 categories. /api/gadgets/catalogue/search?category=subtitle returns 4 subtitle gadgets. /api/gadgets/catalogue/categories returns all 16 categories.

backend_api_downloads_engine.details: /api/downloads/engine/status returns success=true with transfer info (download_rate, upload_rate, num_torrents, dht_nodes).

navigation.details: All navigation links working: Home, Library, Movies, TV Shows, Anime, Playlists, Music, Audiobooks, Streaming, Indexers, Downloads, Settings

context_for_next_testing_agent: All v2.5.6 features are working: Movies/TV/Anime pages have dual Library/Discover views, Gadgets Catalogue at /plugins shows 45 gadgets in 16 categories with search/filter, Downloads engine status shows Built-in Engine Running. Backend APIs fully tested with pytest.
